visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A dark, sepia-toned illustration depicting a desolate, hilly landscape at night. In the background, a small, dark, domed structure sits atop a hill, emitting a bright, horizontal beam of light that cuts across the scene. In the foreground, two dark, contorted, insect-like or skeletal figures lie on the ground, appearing to be in distress or deceased. The sky is filled with swirling, smoky clouds or atmospheric disturbances.
